name: Canvas Status Bar
description: Status bar widget for the canvas area. Populates the #statusbar div with zoom display (percentage + lock/unlock SVG icon, clickable to toggle zoom lock), refresh zoom icon (visibility-toggled, always reserves 18px layout space, visible when unlocked & zoom !== 100%, resets zoom to 100%), locked indicator, workspace path display (flex-shrink:0), and a 'view all' button that triggers fitAll(). All left-side items have flex-shrink:0 for stable layout. Initialized once into the existing #statusbar element.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Populate #statusbar with zoom/locked/workspace/view-all elements (idempotent if already populated)

methods.name: update
methods.signature: (locked: boolean, scale: number, workspaceName: string, onLockToggle: (() => void) | null, fitAll: () => void, resetZoom?: (() => void) | null) => void
methods.description: Refresh all displayed values and wire click handlers

elements: .status-item (refresh zoom icon, visibility-toggled, always reserves 18px, shown when unlocked & scale !== 1, resets to 100%)
